ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of mountains being described as tent-pins in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, particularly in Al-Mizan, this imagery is interpreted not merely as physical stabilization but as a sign of divine precision in maintaining cosmic order (Nizam) and preventing the earth from convulsing. The metaphor underscores Allah's power to anchor the unstable elements of creation, serving as a reminder of the certainty of the Resurrection mentioned in the surrounding verses.
